name: marketplace
description: AI guidance marketplace — roadmap, canon and orchestration as plain markdown files in your repo, plus 3D level-design taste and method, and a agents-info mod, for Claude Code

plugins.name: orchestration
plugins.description: Roadmap + canon as markdown files in the repo (.claude/roadmap.md, .claude/canon/), plus three agent roles that are equal peers beside your main agent: the `scribe` keeps canon + roadmap on the most economical model; the `orchestrator` scopes, delegates each task to the most economical model an independent check can verify, escalates model or effort on failure, verifies on return and reports back; executors code. No MCP server required

plugins.name: level-design
plugins.description: 3D level-design taste and method, engine-agnostic: read the brief, set four dials (openness, density, relief, nature), ban the AI's defaults (square outlines, tiled floors, sprinkled props, lamp carpets, rainbow palettes), pass a measurable pre-flight; a build procedure (measured reference recipes, spec with questions, idempotent build pass, audits, fixed captures, honest delivery) and a level-design-reviewer agent that judges screenshots against the project's canon

plugins.name: agents-info
plugins.description: Agents info mod (function hooks, tested on Claude Code 2.1.287; the mods API is early access): a live band (plan progress bar, workflow phases, one card per running agent with a mascot dressed for its role or its model), a pane (/agents-info) with foldable sections: 5-hour / 7-day limit gauges with their forecast, the agent tree (main agent, scribe and orchestrator side by side) with each agent's resolved model, effort, worked time and usage bar, a per-prompt timeline of subagents (new, resumed, forked), and the session's usage per model × effort; toasts warn on limit thresholds, token budgets, an unexpected model or a main agent eating the session. Read-only: it never blocks or rewrites anything
